newsitem.title: USA: CSCE says trading volume up 10 pct in year to July.
newsitem.headline: CSCE says trading volume up 10 pct in year to July.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange (CSCE) reported Wednesday a 10-percent increase in overall volume in the year ending July 1997 from the same period in 1996, with a total of 7,946,782 contracts traded.
Futures volume rose five percent to 6,130,302 contracts, while options contract trading jumped 30 percent to 1,816,480 lots.
CSCE said coffee futures trading in the year to July 1997 grew 29 percent from the previous year to 1,554,537 contracts, and trading in coffee options increased 60 percent to 897,458 lots.
Cocoa futures trading rose one percent over the same year-ago period and cocoa options trading increased three percent to 214,427 contracts.
In the world sugar market, year-to-date futures volume declined one percent, while options trading rose 13 percent from the same period last year to 703,046 contracts.
